note: The leaf is the Greek page 368 ('δεῖται ἤδη ... LXVIII. Πρῶτον μὲν οὖν'); X gives the English translation from another page (371, 'nature, of a warming character...').
The leaf is the 'CATALOGVS DIALOGORVM' (Primo Tomo, 'Εὐθύφρων ... Pag. 1' to 'Πολιτειῶν ... pag. 327'); X gives the following leaf (Νόμων, Τίμαιος, Sexta Syzygia).
The leaf is SOPHISTA p. 233 ('μάλιστα λέγῃς; ... consilio hoc dicis'); X gives a Cratylus page (400, 'ψυχῆς ... Σῶμα') from elsewhere in the book.
The leaf is PLATONIS p. 128 ('fallamur, dum nostri curam nõ habemus ... σκυτική'); Y gives Alcibiades I p. 133 ('κατοπτρικῷ ὄψει'), a different leaf.
The leaf is THEAETETVS p. 153 ('στρατόπεδον ... exercitum & imperatorem Homerum'); Y gives a Sophista page (254), a different leaf.

The leaf is INTRODUCTION p. 455 ('season to season and from day to day ... Philo, Rer. Div. Her. 43'); X gives p. 458 ('refers in the word λόγος ... Bywater'), a different leaf.
